name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The terrible scorpid, Deathclasp, is believed to have retreated to the southern mountain range in the presence of increased silithid activity.  She presents a great threat to patrols and expeditions in the southern regions.  Individuals participating in her destruction will be remunerated handsomely.  Inquire with Captain Vish Kozus, at the top of the Cenarion Hold Watchtower, regarding a reward.
narrative.objectives: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent! With Deathclasp gone we're free to use the southern mountain range as a strategic path to circumvent the silithid hives. Your work is greatly appreciated.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'll need the creature's pincer as proof of the deed. No pincer, no reward.
